event-title.$: INVENTION PATENT APPLICATION DEEMED WITHDRAWN AFTER PUBLICATION

section.content: 本发明提高学习模型的反馈效率。实施方式的机器学习装置具备：推断部，基于学习模型，针对学习用的数据所包含的要素，按照对要素进行分类的多个类别中的每个类别，推断表示被分类到该类别的可能性的似然；损失值计算部，基于规定的损失函数和由推断部推断出的每个类别的似然，计算表示似然的错误的程度的损失值；权重计算部，基于按照每个类别计算出的似然中的、应将要素分类为真的第一类别的第一似然与不应将要素分类为真的其它类别的第二似然的比较结果来计算权重；以及机器学习部，基于损失值和权重，使学习模型机器学习。

The invention improves the feedback efficiency of the learning model. The machine learning device of the embodiment includes: an estimation unit configured to estimate, for each of a plurality of categories into which an element is classified, a likelihood indicating a possibility of being classified into the category, for the element included in the data for learning, based on the learning model; a loss value calculation unit that calculates a loss value indicating a degree of error of the likelihood based on a predetermined loss function and the likelihood for each category estimated by the estimation unit; a weight calculation unit that calculates a weight based on a result of comparison between a first likelihood that an element should be classified into a first class and a second likelihood that the element should not be classified into another class, among the likelihoods calculated for each class; and a machine learning unit that machine-learns the learning model based on the loss value and the weight.

Machine learning deviceTechnical Field

Embodiments of the present invention relate to a machine learning device.

Background

Conventionally, a technique of classifying elements included in data using a learning model generated by machine learning has been proposed.

Further, a technique has been proposed in which a loss value is calculated using a loss function for a classification result using a learning model, and the learning of the learning model is performed using the loss value. In recent years, the method of calculating the loss value tends to be complicated with the development of the technology. In the conventional technique described in patent document 1, a technique is proposed in which a loss value is calculated by comparing the likelihood of a true value and an estimated value for each category, thereby improving feedback efficiency.

Patent document 1: japanese laid-open patent publication No. 2015-1968

However, in the conventional technique, the relationship between the class having the highest likelihood among the estimated values and the other classes is not considered, and there is room for further improvement in the improvement of the feedback efficiency using the relationship.

Disclosure of Invention

The machine learning device of the embodiment includes, for example: an estimation unit configured to estimate, for each of a plurality of categories into which an element is classified, a likelihood indicating a possibility of being classified into the category, for the element included in the data for learning, based on the learning model; a loss value calculation unit that calculates a loss value indicating a degree of error of the likelihood based on a predetermined loss function and the likelihood for each category estimated by the estimation unit; a weight calculation unit that calculates a weight based on a result of comparison between a first likelihood that an element should be classified into a first class and a second likelihood that the element should not be classified into another class, among the likelihoods calculated for each class; and a machine learning unit that machine-learns the learning model based on the loss value and the weight. According to this configuration, for example, when the learning model is machine-learned, not only the loss value but also the weight based on the comparison result of the first likelihood and the second likelihood is used for machine learning, whereby the likelihood that the target should not be classified into another category of true is also taken into consideration, so that the feedback efficiency can be improved.

In the machine learning device according to the embodiment, for example, the weight calculation unit calculates the weight based on the result of comparison between the first likelihood and the highest second likelihood among the likelihoods of the other categories. According to this configuration, for example, feedback efficiency can be improved by using the highest second likelihood among the likelihoods of the other categories.

In the machine learning device according to the embodiment, for example, the weight calculation unit further calculates the weight based on a difference between the first likelihood and the second likelihood. According to this configuration, for example, by using a weight based on a difference between the first likelihood and the second likelihood for machine learning, the relationship between the class with the highest likelihood and the other classes in the estimated values is also taken into consideration, so that the feedback efficiency can be improved.

In the machine learning device according to the embodiment, for example, the weight calculation unit substitutes a difference value p between the first likelihood and the second likelihood and a predetermined value γ into "W ═ - (1-p)γlog (p) ", to calculate the weight W. According to this configuration, for example, by calculating the weight according to the formula, the weight increases as the difference between the first likelihood and the second likelihood becomes smaller, and therefore the feedback efficiency can be improved.

In the machine learning device according to the embodiment, for example, the loss value calculation unit may set, as the weight, a value larger than the weight calculated when the first likelihood is larger than the second likelihood, when the second likelihood is larger than the first likelihood. According to this configuration, for example, when the second likelihood is larger than the first likelihood, the weight is set to be large, and thus the feedback efficiency can be improved.

Detailed Description

Hereinafter, exemplary embodiments of the present invention are disclosed. The structure of the embodiments described below, and the operation, results, and effects of the structure are examples. The present invention can be realized by a configuration other than the configurations disclosed in the following embodiments, and at least one of various effects and derivative effects based on the basic configuration can be obtained.

Fig. 1 is a diagram showing an example of the hardware configuration of the machine learning apparatus 100. As shown in fig. 1, the machine learning device 100 includes a processor 101, a ROM102, a RAM103, an input unit 104, a display unit 105, a communication I/F106, and an HDD 109. In this example, the machine learning device 100 has the same hardware configuration as a general computer. Note that the hardware elements included in the machine learning device 100 are not limited to those illustrated in fig. 1, and may be a system further including a camera, for example.

The processor 101 is a hardware circuit including, for example, a CPU, a GPU, an MPU, an ASIC, and the like, and executes a program to collectively control the operation of the machine learning device 100, thereby realizing various functions of the machine learning device 100. Various functions of the machine learning device 100 will be described later.

The ROM102 is a nonvolatile memory and stores various data including a program for starting the machine learning device 100. The RAM103 is a volatile memory having a work area of the processor 101.

The input unit 104 is a device for a user using the machine learning apparatus 100 to perform various operations. The input unit 104 is constituted by, for example, a mouse, a keyboard, a touch panel, or hardware keys.

The display unit 105 displays various information. The display unit 105 is configured by, for example, a liquid crystal display, an organic EL (Electro Luminescence) display, or the like. For example, in the case of a touch panel, the input unit 104 and the display unit 105 may be integrally configured. The communication I/F106 is an interface for connecting to a network. An HDD (Hard Disk Drive) 109 stores various data.

Fig. 2 is a block diagram showing a software configuration of the machine learning device 100 according to the present embodiment. As shown in fig. 2, the machine learning device 100 realizes a machine learning unit 201, a data receiving unit 202, an estimating unit 203, a loss value calculating unit 204, and a weight setting unit 205 by the processor 101 executing programs stored in the ROM102 or the HDD 109. The learning data storage unit 206 is stored in the HDD 109.

The learning data storage unit 206 stores data for learning. The data for learning is used for learning to classify elements (pixels in the present embodiment) included in the data into each category. The data for learning includes, in addition to the image data, information (hereinafter, expressed as a true value) indicating to which category each element (pixel in the present embodiment) included in the image data belongs.

In the present embodiment, a case where the data for learning is image data is described, but other data such as a waveform may be used. In addition, although the present embodiment describes a case where the elements to be classified are pixels, the elements may be elements other than pixels.

The data receiving unit 202 receives the data for learning stored in the data storage unit 206 for learning and receives the learning model 210 machine-learned by the machine learning unit 201.

The learning model 210 may use any learning model, for example, a learned CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) model may be used for image analysis.

Fig. 3 is a diagram showing an example of image data for learning according to the present embodiment. The image data shown in fig. 3 is an example of 5 categories including a sky 401, a road surface 402, a vehicle 403, a person 404, and a ground 405. The present embodiment describes a case where the classification into 5 categories is performed as an example. In addition, the number of categories is not limited in the present embodiment, and may be 4 categories or less, or 6 categories or more.

The estimation unit 203 calculates an estimation likelihood indicating a possibility of being classified into each of a plurality of categories for classifying the elements, for each of the elements included in the data for learning, based on the learning model 210 machine-learned by the machine learning unit 201.

Specifically, the estimation unit 203 according to the present embodiment calculates the estimation likelihood for each of 5 categories for each pixel of the image data for learning. The present embodiment is an example of using a Softmax function as an activation function classified into a plurality of classes. The present embodiment is not limited to the method using the Softmax function, and other activation functions may be used. The Softmax function is a function that outputs the probability (estimated likelihood in the present embodiment) that it is true for each category.

The estimation likelihood in the present embodiment is a value that converges in the range of 0 to 1, and the closer to "1", the higher the probability of being the category. Specifically, if the estimated likelihood is "0", the likelihood of being the category is 0%, and if the estimated likelihood is "1", the likelihood of being the category is estimated to be 100%.

Fig. 4 is a diagram illustrating an estimation method when the estimation unit 203 of the present embodiment classifies elements using the learning model 210. As shown in fig. 4, the estimation unit 203 inputs a plurality of input parameters as an input layer 301 for classifying elements included in data for learning. When the data for learning is image data, for example, in addition to the value of an element (pixel) to be classified, the values of pixels around the element are input as input parameters.

As shown in fig. 4, at a plurality of intermediate layers 302, neurons are connected to each other. In the present embodiment, parameters (for example, weight and bias) of each neuron are set based on the learning model 210. In the example shown in fig. 4, input parameters input to the input layer 301 are output as a plurality of output parameters existing in the output layer 303 via neurons connected to each other in the plurality of intermediate layers 302. The number of output parameters in the present embodiment matches the number of categories into which the elements are classified. In other words, as an output parameter of the output layer 303, an inferred likelihood for each category is calculated.

In addition, although the present embodiment describes an example of performing multi-class classification, the present invention is not limited to multi-class classification, and can be applied to a case of performing binary classification.

The probability vector (array of estimated likelihoods) output by the estimation unit 203 of the present embodiment can be represented as [ class 1, class 2, class 3, class 4, and class 5 ]. For example, when the category 1 is "sky", the category 2 is "road surface", the category 3 is "vehicle", the category 4 is "person", and the category 5 is "ground", the pixel 411 of fig. 3 stored in the learning data storage unit 206 indicates "sky", and therefore the true value of the pixel 411 is [1, 0, 0, 0, 0 ].

Further, [0.40, 0.50, 0.05, 0.05, 0.00] is calculated as a first estimation example of the pixel 411.

In the machine learning, the relearning based on the first estimation example is performed. As a result, [0.40, 0.30, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10] is calculated as a second estimation example of the pixel 411. Further, the second inference example based relearning is performed. As a result, [0.40, 0.25, 0.20, 0.15, 0.00] is calculated as a third estimation example of the pixel 411. The first to third estimation examples are examples for the following description, and are not limited to whether or not the calculation is performed by the conventional machine learning or the calculation according to the present embodiment.

In the first estimation example, the estimation likelihood of the category 2 being false is larger than the estimation likelihood of the category 1 being true. Therefore, the first inference example does not agree with the true value.

On the other hand, the second and third estimation examples agree with the true value at the point where the estimation likelihood of the true category 1 is the maximum. However, the inference for category 2 is similar, however, the second inference example is "0.30" and the third inference example is "0.25". Therefore, it is considered that the third estimation example performs more appropriate classification than the second estimation example.

In addition, in the calculation of the loss value based on the conventional machine learning, for example, the cross entropy function, only the estimated likelihood of the true category is used. In other words, in the first to third estimation examples described above, only "0.40" of the category 1 is used for calculating the loss value for machine learning. In other words, since machine learning is performed with the same value regardless of whether the value matches the true value, there is a problem that sufficient feedback cannot be performed. On the other hand, when machine learning is performed using the estimated likelihood of all the categories, there is a problem that noise is large.

Therefore, in the present embodiment, the loss value is weighted based on the highest estimation likelihood of the estimation likelihoods of the class in which the element should be classified as true and the other classes in which the element should be classified as false.

The loss value calculation unit 204 calculates a loss value indicating the degree of error of the estimation likelihood based on a predetermined loss function and the estimation likelihood for each category estimated by the estimation unit 203. In the present embodiment, the loss value L is calculated as a predetermined loss function using a cross entropy function represented by the following expression (1). The variable i is a numerical value indicating a category. Therefore, in the present embodiment, since the number of categories is 5, the variable i is 0 to 4. t is tiThe value is "1" when the category is true, and is "0" when the category is false. y isiAn inferred likelihood for each category (i).

[ formula 1]

The weight setting unit 205 calculates the weight of the loss value. Specifically, the weight setting unit 205 calculates the weight W for each pixel (element) based on the result of comparison between the highest estimated likelihood of the category (true category) in which the pixel (element) should be classified as true and the estimated likelihood of the other category (false category) in which the pixel (element) is false (should not be classified as true), among the estimated likelihoods calculated for the respective categories. In the present embodiment, as a result of the comparison, the weight W is calculated from the difference between the estimated likelihood of the true class and the highest estimated likelihood of the false class.

However, when the estimated likelihood of the false category is greater than the estimated likelihood of the true category, the weight setting unit 205 sets the predetermined value as the weight. The predetermined value may be set to an appropriate value according to the embodiment, but is, for example, a value larger than a weight calculated when the estimated likelihood of the true category is larger than the highest estimated likelihood of the false category.

Specifically, the difference value p is calculated using the following expression (2). The inference likelihood of the true class is Vtarget, and the highest inference likelihood of the false class is Vrem _ max.

p＝max(0.01，Vtarget－Vrem_max)……(2)

According to equation (2), when the highest estimated likelihood of the false category is greater than the estimated likelihood of the true category, the difference value p is 0.01, and when the estimated likelihood of the true category is greater than the highest estimated likelihood of the false category, the difference value p is Vtarget-Vrem _ max.

Then, the weight setting unit 205 substitutes the calculated difference value p into the following expression (3) to calculate the weight W. In addition, the predetermined value γ is set to an appropriate value according to the embodiment, for example, a value between 0 and 5.0 may be assigned.

W＝－(1－p)γlog(p)……(3)

Fig. 5 is a graph showing the weight W calculated by equation (3) based on the difference value p in the weight setting unit 205. As shown in FIG. 5, the difference value p takes a value between 0 and 1. Also, the closer to 0, the larger the weight W.

On the other hand, in the second estimation example [0.40, 0.30, 0.10, 0.10, 0.10]]In the case of (3), the difference value p2 is 0.1. In this case, the weight setting unit 205 calculates the weight W corresponding to the coordinate 5022. In the third extrapolation example [0.40, 0.25, 0.20, 0.15, 0.00]In the case of (3), the difference value p3 is 0.15. In this case, the weight setting unit 205 calculates the weight W corresponding to the coordinate 5011。

As shown in FIG. 5, W3＞W2＞W1. In other words, in the present embodiment, when the estimated likelihood of the false category is greater than the estimated likelihood of the true category, a large weight W is set3. When the estimated likelihood of the true category is greater than the highest estimated likelihood of the false category, the weight W is set so as to decrease as the difference value between the estimated likelihoods increases, as shown in fig. 5. In other words, when the difference value between the estimated likelihoods is small, a large weight W is set. This can improve the efficiency of machine learning.

As described above, in the present embodiment, even if the estimated likelihoods of the true classes are the same, different weights W are calculated from the difference value p.

The machine learning unit 201 performs machine learning based on the loss value L and the weight W, and performs feedback to the learning model 210. Specifically, in the present embodiment, instead of using the loss value L as in the conventional case, the total loss value L calculated according to the following expression (4) is used as the machine learning based on the loss value L and the weight WL. In addition, for using the total loss value LLThe method of performing machine learning on the learning model 210 may be the same as the conventional method, and the description thereof will be omitted.

LL＝L×W……(4)

Next, a process executed by the machine learning device 100 according to the present embodiment will be described. Fig. 6 is a flowchart showing a processing procedure executed by the machine learning apparatus 100 according to the present embodiment.

The data receiving unit 202 of the machine learning device 100 according to the present embodiment receives data (image data) for learning and the learning model 210 machine-learned by the machine learning unit 201 from the learning data storage unit 206 (S601).

Next, the estimation unit 203 calculates an estimation likelihood for each type for each pixel (element) of the data for learning based on the learning model 210 (S602).

Then, the loss value calculation unit 204 calculates a loss value for each pixel (element) based on a predetermined loss function (for example, a cross entropy function) and the estimation likelihood estimated by the estimation unit 203 (S603).

Further, the weight setting unit 205 calculates a weight of the loss value for each pixel (element) based on the estimated likelihood of the true type and the highest estimated likelihood of the false type (S604).

Then, the machine learning unit 201 performs machine learning using the loss value and the weight, thereby performing feedback to the learning model 210 (S605).

After that, the machine learning unit 201 determines whether or not the machine learning is completed (S606). The criterion for determining whether or not the machine learning is completed may be any criterion, and for example, the number of times of learning reaches a predetermined number, the learning model 210 exceeds the target accuracy, or the machine learning based on all the data for learning may be completed.

When determining that the machine learning is not completed (no in S606), the machine learning unit 201 starts the process from S601 again. On the other hand, if it is determined that the machine learning is finished (S606: YES), the process is finished.

In the present embodiment, the description has been given by using the flowchart shown in fig. 6, but machine learning using the learning model 210 may be performed in parallel.

In the present embodiment, an example in which the cross entropy function is used as a method of calculating the loss value is described, but a loss function other than the cross entropy function may be used. For example, a method such as a least square error may be used. Further, the calculation method for calculating the loss value is not limited to using only one method, and a plurality of calculation methods for the loss value may be combined.

In addition, when a plurality of loss values are calculated for each pixel (element) by using a plurality of calculation methods, the loss values of the entire main pixels may be combined into one value and then machine learning may be performed. In such a case, to integrate the loss values, it is considered to use an average, a sum.

In the above-described embodiment, an example in which the highest estimated likelihood among the estimated likelihoods of the false category is compared with the estimated likelihood of the true category is described. However, in the present embodiment, the comparison target of the estimation likelihood of the true category is not limited to the highest estimation likelihood among the estimation likelihoods of the false categories, and may be compared with the average of the estimation likelihoods of the false categories, the second highest estimation likelihood, or the like.

In the present embodiment, compared to the case of performing machine learning based on the conventional loss value L, the weight of the highest estimated likelihood between the estimated likelihood based on the true category and the false category is set, so that the feedback efficiency to the learning model 210 can be improved.

Several embodiments of the present invention have been described, but these embodiments are presented as examples and are not intended to limit the scope of the invention. These new embodiments can be implemented in other various ways, and various omissions, substitutions, and changes can be made without departing from the spirit of the invention. These embodiments and modifications are included in the scope and gist of the invention, and are included in the invention described in the claims and the equivalent scope thereof.
